title: Square White Background Sneaker
tests: Delivers a text-generated marketplace image with the requested square framing and clean white background.

judge.summary: A clean square product photo shows one complete white leather sneaker on a plain white background with no distracting additions.

must_haves.why: The image has equal width and height.

must_haves.item: Exactly one white leather sneaker is shown.
must_haves.why: One white sneaker with smooth leather panels and stitched seams is visible.

must_haves.item: The background is plain white, with no scenery or props.
must_haves.why: The backdrop is plain white with only a soft contact shadow beneath the shoe.

must_haves.item: The entire shoe is visible with space around it.
must_haves.why: The toe, heel, tongue, and sole are fully within the frame, with margins on all sides.

must_haves.item: No promotional text, badges or graphic borders appear.
must_haves.why: No text, badges, or graphic borders are visible.
